en: The image depicts a black-and-white photograph of a funeral procession on a city street. A horse-drawn hearse, ornately decorated and carrying a coffin adorned with flowers, is at the center. The driver and attendants are dressed formally, and many people are following the procession, most of them holding umbrellas, suggesting rainy weather. The buildings lining the street have European architectural features typical of the early 20th century. There are people standing on the sidewalk, some children among them, observing the procession.
